slice.title: Product catalog
slice.goal: Build the initial product catalog prototype: list products, create product records, edit price/category, search by name or SKU, and filter by category using local JSON mock storage.
acceptance_criteria: User can see a list of products with name, SKU, category, and price.
User can create a product with name, SKU, category, and price.
User can edit an existing product's price and category.
User can search products by name or SKU.
User can filter products by category.
The main screen and interactive controls have stable data-prototype-id anchors linked to scheme elements.
The prototype uses local JSON mock storage and does not require external integrations.
constraints: No inventory reservation or stock management in this slice.
No supplier integrations or discount rules in this slice.
Use local JSON mock storage from the sample mock plan.
No new dependencies beyond the selected kit.
Do not implement delete product in this slice.

notes: This scenario intentionally differs from customers-app: it has a category filter and numeric price field, while search covers name and SKU rather than contact fields.
Use it to check whether CRUD/list/search/filter test method contracts generalize beyond notes, tasks, and customers examples.
